summary: Each of ten games has a passing natural-end, result-focus, Space restart and Back case on Chromium and WebKit. These cases are a union across24distinct attempts; all original limits and the failed diagnostic remain retained.

baseline.failures: Both OrbitalCrew attempts remained playing at the unchanged170s result observation limit; no product cause inferred.

distinctGuided.passes: Both OrbitalCrew attempts use actual local Reactor Overdrive heat response then held keyboard controls and reach natural heat/hull loss within the original180s scenario bound. WebKit BodyDodge witnesses fresh keyboard and local Dpad LEFT gate effects.
distinctGuided.failure: Chromium BodyDodge records keyboard LEFT effect, then times out the local Dpad judgment and later observes canvas focus at the result. Cleanup focus may overlap the natural end; missing phase telemetry prevents a causal claim.

pairCoverage.combinedClaimLimit: 20/20 game-engine pairs have a passing natural-end/described-focus/Space-restart/Back lifecycle case and a real observed input effect.19/20 combine those in one passing attempt. Chromium Body input effect is retained from its inconclusive guided attempt; baseline lifecycle case had neutral CENTER admission only. Do not claim20 complete input-to-restart passes.

canonicalHarness.difference: After baseline finished: module local binding renamed roleModule; explanatory comment added to formerly empty diagnostic catch. No runtime behavior change. Exact executed source retained.

sourceScope: Baseline receipt pins117 named source files; guided receipt pins118 (adds its recipe); both pin602 served build files. Source-pin invariance is for those sets, not the entire changing working tree. Later Launcher-only work was outside the source set and dist stayed unchanged during both runs. This is not a claim about a later rebuilt candidate.
sourceAndBuildBoundary: 116 common declared product-source pins and602 non-map distribution files match both completed runs. The source fence is a selected subset, not an exhaustive dependency-closure inventory. Exact initial executed QA bytes and the two later mechanical lint changes are preserved.
limits: The baseline BodyDodge CENTER clear is neutral traversal, not movement proof. Active keyboard evidence comes from distinct guided input.
Result focus and aria-describedby are observed DOM semantics, not an executed assistive-technology announcement.
Post-Space checks witness result detachment and canvas focus, not a fresh post-restart consumer effect.
Conventional controls remain partial; this does not qualify every required/optional role, gamepad, motion/camera or remote control.
No physical phone/controller, assistive-technology, target-OS/native startup or whole G06/U10 acceptance.
All original failed attempts remain current scoped failures; no timeout extension, unchanged retry, clock/game-state override or forced ending.
